test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e84df28bf4210babece582f6180ae48731090f9917d3673f928a7c399ce9426.png]
solution:
Taking dice positions 2 and 4 with 5 as common,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65fb9751bb7dfa0885bcee1a511ddaa3deacaa88f97957ccf9fba57770ba2cbd.png] 

Moving clockwise from the Common number 5,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee142527d510123eef73324a55f5d978235eae3bd6ba1d47cc7b6d1b9a9bc156.png] 

Pair of opposite numbers:

5 - 6

4 - 1

2 - 3

So, the opposite number to 2 is 3.

Hence, the correct answer is "3".
